summary: Distinguish intramolecular O-H bonds from selected illustrative intermolecular connections.
objective: Create a small group of water molecules with solid O-H bonds and dashed illustrative hydrogen bonds.
example_prompts: Create a small group of water molecules with solid O-H bonds and dashed illustrative hydrogen bonds.
Select a dashed link to show that it connects two separate molecules.

entities.name: Water molecules
entities.guidance: Use a small number of bent O-H units with stable molecule and atom IDs.

entities.name: Intermolecular guides
entities.guidance: Connect authored donor hydrogen and neighboring oxygen endpoints with dashed lines.

object_craft.structure: Use a small number of bent O-H units with stable molecule and atom IDs.
object_craft.material: Labeled oxygen/hydrogen colors and solid covalent sticks.

object_craft.structure: Connect authored donor hydrogen and neighboring oxygen endpoints with dashed lines.
object_craft.material: Thin dashed contrasting material with a legend.

state_contract.model: Authored molecule placements and explicit illustrative intermolecular edge list; no distance-threshold bond inference or dynamic equilibrium.
state_contract.authority: Domain state owns identities, values and accepted transitions. Derive labels and meshes from that state; camera and display offsets are separate.
actions: Select a molecular unit or intermolecular edge.
Explode the group for identification then restore it.

invariants: Solid bonds connect atoms within one molecule; illustrated dashed edges connect distinct molecules.
Moving a display group updates its guide endpoints.
A selected edge exposes both endpoint molecule IDs.
motion_guidance: Use a static network by default; any regrouping is labeled presentation, not bond kinetics.
Retain clear separation of the two bond styles from all camera angles.
known_limits: Illustrative small network, not liquid water structure, bond lifetime or force-field simulation.
No universal hydrogen-bond cutoff, energy or occupancy prediction.
Authored recipe only; runtime and rendered geometry checks have not run.

claims.statement: Water molecules can participate in intermolecular hydrogen-bond interactions, distinct from their intramolecular covalent O-H bonds.
claims.scope: Water example only; illustrative edge selection does not establish a quantitative hydrogen-bond detection rule.

physical_contract.scope: Presentation of an authored molecular network.
colliders: None; geometry does not solve intermolecular forces.
physical_contract.timestep: Use a declared fixed update step for changing model state; interpolate presentation only. Pause clears accumulated playback time.
checks: Dashed links connect different molecules and remain attached to their endpoint atoms.
